description: Two analytic GeoParquet assets from the pinned LakeATLAS v1.0 producer File Geodatabase: the complete polygon layer and separate pour-point layer. The deterministic spatially ordered representations preserve producer OBJECTID, Hylak_id and all decoded source fields, nulls, and WKB; WGS84 bbox fields support spatial filtering. No geometries are repaired or simplified. Attribute years vary by source and do not represent a 2026 observation.
